info.title: dotgraph
info.description: CLI tool that detects and cascades version bumps across internally published NuGet packages in a .NET solution.

commands.name: init
commands.description: Scan solution and build initial dependency graph

options.name: --solution
options.description: Path to solution file when multiple exist

commands.name: refresh
commands.description: Rescan solution and update the graph snapshot

options.name: --solution
options.description: Path to solution file when multiple exist

commands.name: analyze
commands.description: Show packages affected by a version change (dry run)

commands.name: sync
commands.description: Auto-detect version changes and apply cascade bumps

options.name: --dry-run
options.description: Print proposals without writing files [default: False]

options.name: --interactive
options.description: Walk through each proposal interactively [default: False]

commands.name: update
commands.description: Bump one or more package versions and cascade

options.name: --dry-run
options.description: Print proposals without writing files [default: False]

options.name: --interactive
options.description: Walk through each proposal interactively [default: False]

commands.name: propose
commands.description: Propose patches from code changes against the compare branch

options.name: --dry-run
options.description: Print the branch proposal without writing files [default: False]

options.name: --force
options.description: Accept earlier releases without an extra question [default: False]

commands.name: review
commands.description: Review branch proposals without writing unless you confirm

options.name: --force
options.description: Accept earlier releases without an extra question [default: False]

commands.name: compare-branch
commands.description: Print or set the branch used for version proposals

arguments.name: NAME
arguments.description: Branch name to store. Omit to print the saved name.

commands.name: props-path
commands.description: Print or set the props file path for package versions

options.name: --clear
options.description: Remove the saved props path [default: False]

arguments.name: PATH
arguments.description: Path to the props file. Omit to print the saved path.

commands.name: export-props
commands.description: Write saved package versions to the configured props file
